review_options: The registered squads and armbands remain the owner’s decisions. These options are independent single swaps. Their gains cannot be added together.

Model squad, 2 free transfers and 0.0 bank: Sánchez → Leno repairs the unavailable reserve goalkeeper, sale 4.9 funds purchase 4.5, projected gain +0.59 over GW6–10. Palmer → Saka is the strongest value option, sale 9.7 funds purchase 9.6, projected gain +13.03.
Captain review: Saka leads the full board at 7.96 xPts. Among the registered model squad, B.Fernandes has 7.16 versus Palmer’s 5.22. The registered Palmer armband awaits owner review.

Consensus squad analysis, 1 free transfer and assumed 0.0 bank: Tzolis → Tavernier is +13.65 and O’Reilly → De Cuyper is +7.86 over GW6–10. Consensus membership follows its crowd-selection policy. These swaps do not update that team.

Chelsea confirm Palmer and João Pedro are available, with no promise of a start or 90 minutes. Both use a provisional 0.75 start probability. At 10,000 simulations per scenario, varying starts from 0.60 to 0.90 and conditional minutes from 60 to 90 puts Palmer at 3.27–6.32 xPts and João Pedro at 2.52–4.92. Saka remains first for captaincy in all three scenarios.

All transfer deltas use the best legal weekly XI plus captain mean, discounted 0.95 per week, and exclude autosub and vice option value. GW6–7 use market prices. GW8–10 use strength estimates. Current feed availability carries into future weeks, so the horizon does not predict injury recovery. These are model estimates without demonstrated prospective superiority.
